answer: Sybil resistance via convex emission weight: an account's reward share grows with the square of its locked bond, so splitting capital S across 500 clones mints 1/500th the influence of one honest account holding S; matching it costs roughly 22x the capital locked. Each bond is a crystal: indivisible, non-transferable, claimable only by its holder. Bonds ride a glacier vault dripping out over twelve epochs, while every clone must send a signed pulse each epoch or forfeit accrual, so the operation parks 22x illiquid capital and runs 500 streams for a yield shrinking with each added head.
